name: Casa Gerardo
dinnerNote: Menú Geles grand tasting menu, booked ahead (Degustación €150, Clásico €88); dinner only in July and August

menus.name: Menú Geles grand tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; must be booked ahead; last orders 2pm at lunch. Wines to go with it: 2 glasses €50, 3 €90 or 5 €150

menus.name: Menú Degustación tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; six snacks, four starters, fish, meat, a taste of fabada, pre-dessert and rice pudding; last orders 2.30pm at lunch

menus.name: Menú Clásico
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; five snacks, a starter, fish, fabada and rice pudding; last orders 3.30pm at lunch

alsoTry.name: À la carte at Casa Gerardo
alsoTry.note: Fabada de Prendes €26.25, mains €22.95–69 and desserts €11.20–15; bread and welcome appetiser €4.50

bookingOpens: Online in the calendar on the restaurant's website, choosing à la carte, a tasting menu or the Menú Geles; a booking only counts once a confirmation email arrives. Last-minute bookings and changes (within 24 hours) are best made by phone.
cancellation: A card is taken to hold the booking. No-shows and cancellations less than 12 hours ahead are charged €50 a person; cancellations within 48 hours are best made by phone.
groups: Groups of eight or more must agree a menu in advance.
